risks.title: Interest Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk is disclosed in Item 7A and concerns variable-rate debt. A 1 percentage point rate increase would result in an additional $1.3M in interest expense. Measured language, but direct impact on earnings. Capital category weighted moderately.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Present in Item 7A, with significant impact on sales and pricing. Dollar strengthening or weakening affects intercompany transactions and competitiveness. Currency impact mechanisms in place. Language highlights a major risk, especially for transatlantic operations.

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Identified in Item 7A, related to steel and natural gas purchases. Managed through supplier price contracts. Moderate but recurring risk, with uncertainty in commodity markets. Less acute than FX or rate risk.

risks.title: U.S. Pension Obligations
risks.score_rationale: Presented as Critical Audit Matter, obligation estimated in millions. High uncertainty on discount rates. Technical language and concerns, with involvement of actuarial specialists. Existential risk if underestimated.

risks.title: Tariff Costs
risks.score_rationale: Additional tariff costs of $65M in 2025, with direct impact on operating profit. Highlighted as a key factor in profit decline. Upward trend anticipated in 2026 with ongoing margin impact.

ai_positioning.summary: Company TKR does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
